app.title: AI activity in Ontario
map.instructions: Use the arrow keys to pan the map, and the plus and minus keys to zoom. Every mapped record is also listed in the table below this map.
legend.title: Legend
legend.area: Soft area — location known only to the municipality
legend.cluster: Numbered circle — several records grouped; click to list them
cluster.heading: records at this point
cluster.sharedPoint: These records share one municipal centroid, so zooming will not separate them. The circle is drawn a little off that point so that layers do not hide one another.
popup.claimCaveat: This site has been announced but not built. Announcements change, and some are never built.
popup.approximateCaveat: This point marks the municipality, not an address.
table.caption: Every mapped record, as a table.
table.name: Name
empty.title: No records yet
empty.body: No source has cleared its licence check, so no records have been published. The map is deliberately empty rather than provisional.
error.title: The data could not be loaded
nowebgl.title: The map needs WebGL
nowebgl.body: This browser cannot draw the map, so the same records are shown as a table below.
